requirements.name: connection-rels
requirements.message: The assembly default prim has a `Connections` Scope. Each connection prim under it authors exactly one `simready:mate:socket` relationship and exactly one `simready:mate:plug` relationship, each with exactly one target.

requirements.name: assembly-type
requirements.message: The assembly default prim must author `simready:mate:assemblyType` with exactly one value drawn from the closed list `robot`, `pallet_stack`. A missing attribute or an unrecognized token fails.

requirements.name: exclusive-pairing
requirements.message: No mate site may appear in more than one connection: a socket holds at most one plug, and a plug sits in at most one socket.

requirements.name: mate-realization
requirements.message: Every connection prim must author `simready:mate:realization` as either `compound` or `jointed`, and the token must agree with how the two mate bodies resolve. `jointed` requires two distinct mate bodies; `compound` requires one shared mate body and must not author `simready:mate:joint`.

requirements.name: opposite-roles
requirements.message: The two targets of a connection must have opposite roles: one `Socket` and one `Plug`.

requirements.name: assembly-model-hierarchy
requirements.message: The assembly default prim must have `kind = "assembly"`. Each composed-in child asset root must have `kind = "component"` or `kind = "assembly"`, and every prim between the default prim and a child asset root that carries a model kind must be `group` or `assembly`, so the model hierarchy is contiguous.

requirements.name: interface-match
requirements.message: The socket and plug `simready:mate:mechanical:interface` tokens must be equal by exact string comparison.

requirements.name: connection-joint
requirements.message: Every connection with `realization = "jointed"` must author `simready:mate:joint` targeting exactly one `UsdPhysicsFixedJoint` whose `physics:body0` and `physics:body1` resolve to the connection's two mate bodies, whose local poses place the socket and plug frames coincident, and which authors explicit `physics:breakForce` and `physics:breakTorque`.

requirements.name: payload-capacity
requirements.message: Socket `simready:mate:mechanical:maxPayload` must be greater than or equal to the plug subtree mass. Incomplete mass on rigid bodies in that subtree warns rather than fails. Only `jointed` connections are checked; a compound has no joint to rate.

requirements.name: newton-connection-joint
requirements.message: A `jointed` connection joint must remain a standard `UsdPhysicsFixedJoint` with explicit `physics:collisionEnabled = false`, must not apply `NewtonJointAPI` degree-of-freedom tuning, and when it fuses two articulations exactly one `PhysicsArticulationRootAPI` may survive on the composed assembly.

requirements.name: mujoco-connection-joint
requirements.message: A `jointed` connection joint must remain a standard `UsdPhysicsFixedJoint` with explicit `physics:collisionEnabled = false`, must not apply `MjcJointAPI`, must not be targeted by an `MjcActuator`, and must not author an invented MuJoCo weld or fixed-joint schema.

requirements.name: assembly-child-references
requirements.message: Each connected mate site must arrive on the assembly stage through a reference or payload arc to a separately published asset. Parts authored inline in the assembly's own root layer fail.

requirements.name: connection-targets-resolve
requirements.message: Each `socket` and `plug` relationship target must resolve on the composed stage and satisfy `MC.001` and `MC.002`.

requirements.name: physx-connection-joint
requirements.message: A `jointed` connection joint must remain a standard `UsdPhysicsFixedJoint` with explicit `physics:collisionEnabled = false`, must not apply `PhysxJointAPI` degree-of-freedom tuning, and must leave `physics:excludeFromArticulation` false or unset; when it fuses two articulations, exactly one `PhysicsArticulationRootAPI` may survive on the composed assembly.

requirements.name: compound-body
requirements.message: The mate body shared by a `compound` connection must be an assembly-local prim carrying no reference or payload arc, with an enabled `PhysicsRigidBodyAPI` and a `physics:mass` equal to the sum of the parts it fuses. It may omit that aggregate only when the parts carry their mass on their colliders, which the runtime sums to the same total. Every part beneath it must author `physics:rigidBodyEnabled = false`, and no joint may sit beneath it.
